title: MEIKO — Original Style〔Part2〕Side Story (Part 2)

rows.Line: VIRTUAL SINGER Stage

rows.Speaker: MEIKO
rows.Line: Hey, you guys! You can still keep going, right?!

rows.Speaker: MEIKO
rows.Line:
What about you guys in the crowd?
Are you having a good time?!

rows.Speaker: KAITO
rows.Line: How about our audience watching us live on stream and the remote screenings?

rows.Speaker: Comments
rows.Line:
<Having the best time!>
<Such a hyped medley!>
<This is the best!>

rows.Speaker: Miku
rows.Line: Looks like everyone is having a great time!

rows.Speaker: MEIKO
rows.Line:
I'm glad to hear that!
Now let's keep raising the energy from here!

rows.Speaker: Miku
rows.Line: That reminds me, all of the songs you've been singing have had such a cool and mature energy to them, MEIKO.

rows.Speaker: KAITO
rows.Line: That's true. You had us sing some of them with you, but you really did hit it out of the park each time.

rows.Speaker: MEIKO
rows.Line: Hahaha, thank you!

rows.Speaker: MEIKO
rows.Line: By the way, I didn't intentionally put more of those types of songs in my list. The songs I wanted to sing just ended up being those.

rows.Speaker: MEIKO
rows.Line: But I suppose they matched the impressions people had of me on that program I was on recently.

rows.Speaker: Miku
rows.Line: Oh, yeah! KAITO and I were invited to that same program too!

rows.Speaker: Miku
rows.Line: It was quite interesting how they interviewed people on the street about their impressions of you.

rows.Speaker: Miku
rows.Line: There were a lot of people who found you mature and attractive, right?

rows.Speaker: MEIKO
rows.Line:
Yeah...
I do wear red most of the time, so I wonder if that encouraged that impression of me.

rows.Speaker: Miku
rows.Line: Your red outfit is amazing. It stands out on stage and enhances your presence. I think it suits you the best.

rows.Speaker: Miku
rows.Line: Oh, see? Everyone here agrees with me!

rows.Speaker: MEIKO
rows.Line:
Oh, that's so lovely.
Thank you, Miku, everyone!

rows.Speaker: MEIKO
rows.Line: I've been trying to be very conscious of a variety of things while singing today. So I hope you're ready for the songs coming your way!

rows.Speaker: KAITO
rows.Line: While we're on the topic, could you tell us what you were being conscious of when singing?

rows.Speaker: Miku
rows.Line: I want to know too♪

rows.Speaker: MEIKO
rows.Line:
Even the crowd too?
I guess I have to share now, don't I?

rows.Speaker: MEIKO
rows.Line: Well today's concert is a little special in that all of us are singing songs together that we usually would alone together, right?

rows.Speaker: MEIKO
rows.Line: So I've been trying to show more of myself and how I sing more than usual, not only during my own songs but during others as well.

rows.Speaker: KAITO
rows.Line: I see... More of yourself, huh?

rows.Speaker: MEIKO
rows.Line: Especially since the creators that wrote my songs specifically chose me to sing them...

rows.Speaker: MEIKO
rows.Line: I wanted to make sure to stand proud and sing them with confidence.

rows.Speaker: Miku
rows.Line: To not only be aware of those things, but to put them into practice perfectly too... That's incredible.

rows.Speaker: KAITO
rows.Line: I agree. I feel like that is one of the cool things about you, MEIKO.

rows.Speaker: MEIKO
rows.Line: Thank you. But you know compliments won't get you anywhere.

rows.Speaker: MEIKO
rows.Line: Oh, looks like we're ready to move on to the next song!

rows.Speaker: MEIKO
rows.Line: Hehe. We've been talking about how cool I am, but I'd like you all to see the cute side to me too, right, Miku?

rows.Speaker: Miku
rows.Line: Yeah! Let's get everyone blushing and giddy!

rows.Speaker: KAITO
rows.Line:
Blushing and giddy?
What kind of song are you planning to sing?

rows.Speaker: MEIKO
rows.Line: You'll just have to wait to find out♪

rows.Speaker: MEIKO
rows.Line: Alright then...

rows.Speaker: MEIKO & Miku
rows.Line: Start the music!
